summary_1line: Bhishma continues cataloging Pandava allies, ranking many warriors—Sikhandin, Dhrishtadyumna, Dhrishtaketu, and others—by martial class and predicting their fierce roles in the coming war.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sikhandin, banner flying, rides at the head of Panchala chariots as drums thunder across the battlefield.
Dhrishtadyumna stands in his chariot like a blazing god of destruction, bow drawn as vast divisions of soldiers surge behind him.
The Rakshasa prince Ghatotkacha looms above the field at night, surrounded by fierce demon warriors and shrouded in illusion.
